# 1 Clement Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 10

**10:1** Abraham, who was called "Friend," was found faithful in that he was obedient to the words of God.

**10:2** He went out in obedience from his land and from his kindred and from his father's house, that leaving a small land and a feeble clan and a little house he might inherit the promises of God. For he says to him: [Gen 12:1]

**10:3** "Go out from your land and from your kindred and from your father's house, into the land which I will show you; and I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will magnify your name, and you shall be blessed; and I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you, and all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed in you." [Gen 12:1-3 LXX]

**10:4** And again, when he separated from Lot, God said to him: "Lift up your eyes and look from the place where you are now, northward and southward and eastward and westward, for all the land which you see I will give to you and to your seed forever; and I will make your seed as the dust of the earth; if anyone can count the dust of the earth, your seed also shall be counted." [Gen 13:14-16 LXX]

**10:5** And again he says: "God led Abraham out and said to him: 'Look up into heaven and count the stars if you are able to count them; so shall your seed be.' And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him as righteousness." [Gen 15:5-6 LXX]

**10:6** Because of his faith and hospitality a son was given him in old age; and by obedience he offered him as a sacrifice to God upon one of the mountains which God showed him. [Gen 21; 22]

---

*EMET: "Friend" — *philos* in the LXX tradition; cf. Isa 41:8, 2 Chr 20:7. Abraham as "friend of God" (*philos tou theou*) is a title preserved in both Jewish and Christian tradition.*
